# Miles to Memories

> > Miles to Memories is a travel rewards and deals blog helping readers maximize credit card points, airline miles, and gift card savings for affordable travel.

Founded by Danny the Deal Guru and Mark Ostermann, the site focuses on credit card bonuses (especially American Express, Chase Ultimate Rewards), gift card deals with cashback multipliers, and strategic travel hacking techniques. Content includes deal alerts, card reviews, and travel tips for maximizing rewards programs like Membership Rewards, Southwest Rapid Rewards, and Delta SkyMiles.

## Key Topics

- Credit card rewards and bonuses
- American Express (Amex) cards and offers
- Chase Ultimate Rewards points
- Gift card deals and discounts
- 5x points earning strategies
- Airline miles and loyalty programs
- Membership Rewards transfers
- Southwest Airlines Rapid Rewards
- Delta SkyMiles
- Amex Offers
- Welcome bonuses without lifetime restrictions
- Swych gift card promotions
- Hotel loyalty programs (Hyatt)
- Travel hacking techniques
- Cashback and statement credits
